posts.body: does anyone have ideas i want to earn a little bit of extra cash from working at home i work 16 hours a week at the weekend and look after izzy all week i cant really afford to work anymore hours than i already am i have looked at full time jobs etc but i am struggling and currently im not getting any finanical support from her dad as he is again not working so i want something that i can do from home but i really dont know where to start so if anyone could suggest something cos you see all these things earn extra cash doing this and doing that and there are just scams.
Erm avon?? Not really sure sorry
thats my problem i know a few people who do that so i wouldnt no anyone to sell to people i know do avon and bodyshop things already
body shop, virgin Vie, Tupperware, osbourne books???

Usborne books are really good, how old is your LO? The good thing is a lot of the places that you can sell are places you'd be able to take LO with you, such as parent and toddler, playgroups, nurseries, soft play areas etc. Plus you'll have loads of fab books to read to your LO too.
Let me know if you want more info, I'm a rep and have an 8month old too.
we are thinking of starting a party plan from our range of products at fantasticals.co.uk. Havent really thought this through how it would work etc or even if it would work.

I have been working from home for 3 and a half years around my 3 children Daniel 7 Davina 6 and Deanna 20months and i also work part time 20hrs a week and my husband works full time, I have tried a load of things over the years some things i got ripped off with, scams and somethings were near impossible to do, however i have been doing Kleeneze now and found this was the only one i found that gave me an immediate income we earn anywhere from £800-£960 every 4 weeks for about 10hrs a week. Have a look around there are good opportunities out there but if you are at all concerned get in contact with the Office of Fair Trading they have a list of legitimate companies so as you don't get scammed. If you want further information about what i do just reply to this post, but whatever you choose to do good luck and i hope this helps,
Cheers
Lorrie

I started selling Tish Tash Toys since last May and have been doing really well at it. I sold nearly £2000 of stuff through parties last November and I also work full time so it can be done.
No MLM is a get rich quick scheme and you do have to put effort into getting bookings etc and there is alwasy an outlay of some sort.
PM me if you want any other info on anything to do with MLM.
Alison

Just wanted to add another partyplan company to the list of suggestions.
I sell Truly Madly Baby products, you might have seen the company on the BBC" programme Dragons Den, they won investment for the idea.
We sell a great range of baby/toddler products which sell themselves and if you already have lo's you probably already know people who will be interested in them, and because we are still quite a young company the market is not saturated with our consultants.
Anyway it's another idea, get in touch if you'd like to know more.
